# GSAP 3.15.0 — licence note

`gsap.min.js` and `Flip.min.js` are copied unmodified from the `gsap@3.15.0` npm
package (`dist/`). The package ships no licence file; each file's header carries
the copyright line and points to the licence.

GSAP is not open source. It is distributed under GreenSock's standard "no charge"
licence. Read the current terms before reusing these files outside this mockup:
https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/

Copyright belongs to its owner as stated in the file headers. These files are
vendored so the presentation mockups run with no network.
